title: Pentagon UAP Release Includes Account of Mysterious Aircraft
description: Federal agents say they watched a dark triangle rise soundlessly over a mountain, hang in the air, then streak away at fighter-jet speed—and they still don't know what it was. Their account of a 15-foot "matte black" craft, unable to be picked up on thermal imaging and labeled an...

title: How will Democrats address UFO sightings if returned to the majority?
description: Unidentified flying objects (UFOs) have long captivated Americans — a majority of whom, recent polling suggests, believe the government is hiding information about the phenomena. And the debate has also made its way to Capitol Hill. In recent years, conversations surrounding UFOs, which the government now refers to as unidentified anomalous phenomena (UAPs), have heated…

title: Catalina Island site of several decades-old unverified UFO filings
description: Catalina Island is the site of four unverified reports of unidentified flying objects from the 1940s and 1950s, according to the latest tranche of records released by the Trump administration on unidentified anomalous phenomena.

title: UFO files detail strange, silent triangular craft: "Absolute acoustic silence"
description: Federal agents encountered a large aircraft that zoomed across the sky from a standstill while making no noise or giving off any exhaust, according to new files.
